A unique identifier assigned by the Employer of Record (EoR) platform to the Customer (that is the company using the EoR service) for which the employee is employed. This ID groups employees under this Customer, enabling the aggregation of contribution reporting and other values per Customer rather than per legal entity. This parameter is only available to EoR platforms.
